# Note Template

Use this template when you need note in the authorized project. Replace placeholders, adapt the examples to the detected toolchain, and preserve the requested output contract. Do not treat sample values or commands as verified deployment settings.

## Navigation

<!-- BEGIN:nav -->
- Parent: `$CODEX_HOME/docs/templates/overview.md`
- Pack index: `$CODEX_HOME/INDEX.md`
- Routing guide: `$CODEX_HOME/index/OVERVIEW.md`
<!-- END:nav -->

## Summary

- One-paragraph statement of the decision, finding, or outcome.

## Details

- Key context, assumptions, and evidence (commands, outputs, or links).
- Explicit constraints/non-goals so future edits preserve intent.

## After that, check related files

- Link related docs, plans, or rollout artifacts.
